title: 初めての、自分たちの収穫
change: 育てた庭葉が初めて料理になる。選別後の使える量を測り、次の納品へ渡す。
state: 第一播種の育った二区画、計8m²を収穫。遅い一区画は残す。使用可能量は約5.1kgという創作上の実測。全48m²を同時収穫しない。

sources.description: First small mature leafy sections at day thirty-five, other later-sown sections still small, one shaded first section smaller; Elna crouches excited, Kou checks one leaf. Gentle morning tower light, no enormous vegetables.
dialogue: 一株、厨房で確かめよう。
sources.scrollPurpose: 導入の場所と前話の状態を引き継ぐ

sources.description: Three unequal hand shots: clean harvest basket on path, Kou cuts garden-leaf crop above soil carefully, leaves placed gently without crushing or dirty roots. Elna watches. Only selected mature sections harvested.
dialogue: 土を、葉につけないように。
育った二区画だけ、今日は採ろう。
sources.scrollPurpose: 相手の知識を聞いて受け止める

sources.description: Elna and Kou sort leaves at designated utility table, usable irregular small leaves in one basket, damaged leaves separately in reject tray. Closeups genuine leaves and hands. Do not present rotten material as food.
dialogue: 重さと、使える分を分ける。
小さくても、使える葉はある。
傷んだ分とは、混ぜないでおこう。
sources.scrollPurpose: 手順と判断を短い動作でつなぐ

sources.description: Mechanical beam scale weighing baskets, Kou records simple tally in notebook, Elna sees modest harvest. No giant produce mountain; approximately five kilograms usable total across harvested sections.
dialogue: 使える分は、五キロほど。
まず、この量で考えよう。
残した区画は、まだ待つ。
sources.scrollPurpose: 気づきの前後で速度を落とす

sources.description: Kitchen washed harvest transferred separately, Elna slices leaves to bite-sized pieces, Kou sets clean bowl; three different-size closeups and medium cooking view. Stable cream apron and blue headscarf.
dialogue: この大きさなら、使いやすい。
洗っても、しっかりしてる。
食べやすい切り方にしよう。
sources.scrollPurpose: 選んだ行動と結果を確かめる

sources.description: Large borderless appetizing hero composition: steaming grain-and-meat bowl topped with bright freshly cooked garden-leaf greens, bowl near auburn young adult customer's rough hands, lower warm eager face before first bite. Food richly drawn, no added text except exact small speech balloon.
sources.scrollPurpose: 説明の後に反応を待つ

sources.description: Three panels: customer enjoys first bite silently; closeup Kou's relieved face after weeks of waiting; Elna beside him with soft pleased expression. Calm adult emotion, no instant buff numbers. Diner warm, crop plot distant.
dialogue: やっと、畑が皿になった。
sources.scrollPurpose: 次の仕事へ状態を渡す

sources.description: Warm evening kitchen, Kou and Elna prepare clean containers beside remaining harvest basket, Leon at doorway confirms next morning delivery. No already-packed food stored overnight: preparation is containers and schedule.
dialogue: 採れた。次は、届ける番だ。
今日は、容器と段取りだけ。
sources.scrollPurpose: 今回の成果を受け止めて次話へ進む
